description: TEMPLATE — do not trust raw. Render with `<installed>/scripts/polylane-hooks.sh render codex` to substitute __POLYLANE_HOOKS_HELPER__ with the absolute installed helper path plus its sha256, then review and trust the result through Codex /hooks. Project-scoped; never changes global configuration or permissions. If the helper is absent the guarded command is a silent no-op.

hooks.command: h='__POLYLANE_HOOKS_HELPER__'; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; exec "$h" codex SessionStart --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
h='__POLYLANE_HOOKS_HELPER__'; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; exec "$h" codex PreCompact --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
h='__POLYLANE_HOOKS_HELPER__'; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; exec "$h" codex PostCompact --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
h='__POLYLANE_HOOKS_HELPER__'; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; exec "$h" codex Stop --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
